grade_description: Adequate baseline, but notable configuration weaknesses increase exposure.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
findings.description: The server does not enforce HTTPS via the Strict-Transport-Security header.
findings.impact: Vulnerable to SSL-stripping and man-in-the-middle downgrade attacks on insecure Wi-Fi/networks.
findings.remediation: Add 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload' to all HTTPS responses.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
findings.description: No Content-Security-Policy header was returned by the server.
findings.impact: Lack of CSP drastically increases vulnerability to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), malicious script injection, and clickjacking.
findings.remediation: Define and deploy a strict CSP restricting script, object, and style sources (e.g. default-src 'self').

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options / Clickjacking Protection
findings.description: The application does not provide clickjacking protection via X-Frame-Options or CSP 'frame-ancestors'.
findings.impact: Attackers can embed the target page in a hidden iframe on a malicious site to trick users into unintended actions.
findings.remediation: Configure 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or 'SAMEORIGIN', or use CSP 'frame-ancestors 'self''.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options Header
findings.description: The 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' header is missing from server responses.
findings.impact: Older or legacy browsers may sniff the response MIME type, potentially executing uploaded text or images as HTML/JavaScript.
findings.remediation: Add 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' to all HTTP responses.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings.description: The server does not specify a Referrer-Policy.
findings.impact: Sensitive URLs with session tokens, user IDs, or internal query parameters may leak in the Referer header to external third parties.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy Header
findings.description: The server does not restrict browser device capabilities using Permissions-Policy.
findings.impact: Enables embedded third-party scripts or iframes to request sensitive browser APIs (camera, geolocation, microphone).

findings.title: Web Server Version Banner Disclosure
findings.description: The server exposes internal technology metadata via 'server: GitHub.com'.
findings.impact: Facilitates targeted attacker reconnaissance and CVE matching.
findings.remediation: Mask or suppress the 'server' response header in your web server/application configuration.

regulatory_exposure.PCI-DSS 4.0: NON-COMPLIANT (Req 4.1: Strong Cryptography & Req 6.4: Web Security)

bia.financial_impact_rating: Elevated - Vulnerable to targeted attacks and regulatory scrutiny
bia.reputational_risk_rating: High - Potential customer churn and security advisory disclosures
bia.executive_summary: The security posture assessment for 'https://owasp.github.io/juice-shop/' yielded an overall score of 75.0/100 (Grade: C). The audit identified 0 Critical, 1 High, 2 Medium, and 3 Low severity findings. Immediate remediation is recommended. The presence of high-severity vulnerabilities exposes the organization to elevated regulatory risk under frameworks like PCI-DSS and GDPR, as well as potential session hijacking, data leakage, or infrastructure compromise.
